why.heading: Where the remodeling money is
why.intro: Homeowners keep spending on their houses, and replacement projects take a big share. Larger firms that sell those projects as product lines are gaining ground.

cards.title: Replacements lead the spending
cards.body: Projects such as roofing, windows and HVAC made up 49 percent of homeowner improvement spending in 2023, per Harvard's Joint Center for Housing Studies.

cards.title: Bigger firms are taking share
cards.body: General remodelers with revenues of at least $2.5 million grew their share of industry receipts from 45 percent in 2007 to 57 percent in 2017.

cards.title: How exterior jobs get paid
cards.body: In 2023, 10 percent of homeowner spending on exterior replacements was paid with home equity and 18 percent with insurance settlements. If you offer financing, say how it works.

services.heading: What ASP runs for remodelers
services.intro: Remodeling buyers research before they call, so your website and ads have to carry much of the sale.

cards.title: Project-type SEO
cards.body: A page for each project type you want more of that buyers search for, such as kitchens, baths, siding or windows, with cost breakdowns and side-by-side comparisons.

cards.title: Google Search and LSA
cards.body: Search Ads reach homeowners pricing a project now. Local Services Ads categories include bathroom and kitchen remodeling, general contractor, roofers, siding and window repair, where offered.

cards.title: Facebook and Instagram
cards.body: Remodeling decisions take weeks, so finished-project photos and video get time to work. The offer is a design consultation or a real estimate.

cards.title: Business Profile and reviews
cards.body: Each Google Business Profile kept current with project photos, service areas and weekly posts, plus a steady flow of review requests.

cards.title: StormFront for exterior firms
cards.body: Roofing companies with storm-driven demand can add weather-triggered content that publishes when storms hit your service area.

cards.title: Signed-project attribution
cards.body: Call tracking and form fields carry each lead's source into your CRM, so reports show signed projects and revenue by channel instead of lead counts.

process.heading: How we start with a remodeling firm

steps.title: Take the Growth Diagnostic
steps.body: It takes about 90 seconds online and shows where your marketing stands before we pitch anything.

steps.title: Walk through the accounts
steps.body: After a 30-minute call, we review your site, ad accounts and tracking. The findings are yours whether you hire us or not.

steps.title: Wire leads to signed jobs
steps.body: Tracking comes first, so each campaign is judged on the projects it signs rather than the leads it collects.

steps.title: Weight budget to capacity
steps.body: Spend leans toward the project types your crews and subcontractors can deliver, then gets reviewed against signed revenue every month.

pricing.heading: Pick the package that fits your pipeline
pricing.subhead: Every package includes organic SEO for your project pages. From Growth up, ASP also manages your Google, Meta and Local Services Ads campaigns.

faqs.question: What is remodeling contractor marketing?
faqs.answer: It is the search, ads, content and follow-up that bring homeowners to you for kitchen, bath and exterior projects, plus the tracking that shows which of those efforts produced signed work.

faqs.question: Do Facebook ads work for remodeling companies?
faqs.answer: Remodeling suits Meta well because the decision takes weeks and finished-project photos have time to do their job. We retarget people who visited your project pages before spending on cold audiences.

faqs.question: How do we know which channel is working?
faqs.answer: Judge it by signed projects, not lead counts. For firms between $1 million and $3 million in revenue, we compare first-touch and last-touch credit. Between $3 million and $10 million, a simple multi-touch model becomes worth the effort.

faqs.question: Our crews are already stretched. Should we still market?
faqs.answer: Yes, with the budget aimed carefully. In 2023, 64 percent of residential remodelers reported some or serious shortages of skilled trade subcontractors, so we weight spend toward the project types your team can deliver.

faqs.question: Do you work with roofing, siding and window companies?
faqs.answer: Yes. Exterior replacement firms use the same method with their own product lines and calendars, and roofers with storm-driven demand can add StormFront.

cta.heading: See which projects your marketing signs
cta.body: Book a 30-minute audit call. You get findings on your site, ads and tracking, and a clear list of what to fix first.
